caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a glass pitcher rendered in shades of blue and purple. The pitcher has a wide, rounded base that tapers to a narrower neck before flaring out again into a wide, undulating rim. The body of the pitcher is bulbous with subtle swirling textural details, and it sits on a small, flat circular foot. The handle is attached near the rim and curves outward in a large loop, with a decorative curl at its base. The glass material is shown with translucent effects and subtle highlights, and the pitcher is the only object against a plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature "VAN. SILVEY" is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Pitcher
